tasks.title: Setup Project Foundation
tasks.description: Initialize the Next.js project with TypeScript, configure Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI components, and set up the basic folder structure.
tasks.details: Create a new Next.js project with TypeScript support using 'npx create-next-app@latest --typescript'. Install and configure Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, and Zod for validation. Set up the project structure with folders for components, pages, hooks, utils, and types. Initialize Git repository and create the initial commit.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify successful project creation by running the development server and confirming all dependencies are correctly installed. Create a simple test page to ensure Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI components render correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication System
tasks.description: Set up Supabase authentication with Google and email sign-up options, create user data models, and implement authentication flows.
tasks.details: Initialize Supabase client and configure environment variables. Create authentication UI components (sign-up, login, password reset). Implement authentication context provider for React. Set up protected routes and middleware for authentication checks. Create the Users table in Supabase with required fields: id, email, created_at, subscription_status.
tasks.testStrategy: Test user registration, login, and logout flows. Verify authentication persistence across page refreshes. Test protected routes to ensure they redirect unauthenticated users. Validate that user data is correctly stored in the Supabase database.

tasks.title: Create Database Schema and Storage Setup
tasks.description: Design and implement the complete database schema in Supabase and configure AWS S3 for image storage.
tasks.details: Create Supabase tables for Sessions, Compositions, and Images with all required fields as specified in the PRD. Set up relationships between tables. Configure AWS S3 bucket for image storage with appropriate CORS settings. Create folders for source images and generated images. Implement utility functions for S3 operations (upload, download, delete). Set up Supabase Edge Functions for secure S3 operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify database schema by inserting and querying test data. Test S3 integration by uploading and retrieving test images. Validate that relationships between tables work correctly. Test access control to ensure users can only access their own data.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Style Composition System
tasks.description: Develop the interface for creating and managing multiple style compositions with selection of background, outfit, and photographic styles.
tasks.details: Create UI components for style selection (backgrounds, outfits, colors, photographic styles). Implement composition creation flow with real-time preview using placeholder models. Develop composition management interface for creating, editing, and deleting compositions. Implement logic for calculating total headshots based on number of compositions according to the PRD specifications. Store composition data in the Compositions table with appropriate status tracking.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the style selection UI with all available options. Verify that composition previews render correctly. Test the composition management interface for creating, editing, and deleting compositions. Validate that the headshot calculation logic works correctly for all tier scenarios.

subtasks.title: Create Style Selection UI Components
subtasks.description: Develop UI components for selecting different style options including backgrounds, outfits, colors, and photographic styles.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a Style Selection panel with categorized tabs for backgrounds, outfits, colors, and photographic styles
2. Design and implement thumbnail grid components for visual selection of each style option
3. Add hover states and selection indicators for style options
4. Implement color pickers for color customization options
5. Create filter/search functionality to help users find specific styles
6. Ensure all components are responsive and accessible
7. Store selected options in local state initially

Testing approach:
- Test UI rendering across different screen sizes
- Verify selection state changes correctly when options are clicked
- Test filter/search functionality with various inputs
- Ensure keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility

subtasks.title: Implement Composition Creation Flow with Preview
subtasks.description: Build the workflow for creating new style compositions with real-time preview using placeholder models.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a multi-step composition creation wizard interface
2. Integrate the style selection components from subtask 1
3. Implement a composition naming/metadata input form
4. Develop a real-time preview component showing selected styles applied to placeholder model images
5. Add composition validation to ensure all required style elements are selected
6. Implement temporary state management to hold composition data during creation
7. Create a composition summary view before final creation
8. Add appropriate navigation controls between creation steps

Testing approach:
- Test the full creation flow from start to finish
- Verify preview updates correctly when style selections change
- Test validation logic with various incomplete selections
- Ensure wizard state persists correctly between steps
- Test responsive behavior of the preview component

subtasks.title: Develop Composition Management System with Database Integration
subtasks.description: Implement the interface and logic for managing compositions, including storage in the Compositions table and headshot calculation.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a compositions list view showing all user compositions with sort/filter options
2. Implement CRUD operations for compositions (create, read, update, delete)
3. Develop the database integration with the Compositions table, including proper status tracking
4. Implement the logic for calculating total headshots based on number of compositions per PRD specifications
5. Create detailed view for individual compositions with edit capabilities
6. Add confirmation dialogs for destructive actions like deletion
7. Implement pagination or infinite scrolling for large numbers of compositions
8. Add error handling and loading states for database operations

Testing approach:
- Test composition creation, editing, and deletion with database persistence
- Verify headshot calculation logic with various composition configurations
- Test error handling with simulated network failures
- Verify status tracking updates correctly throughout composition lifecycle
- Test performance with large numbers of compositions

tasks.title: Implement Payment System
tasks.description: Integrate payment processing for the different pricing tiers with secure checkout and order confirmation.
tasks.details: Integrate Stripe for payment processing with secure API handling. Implement pricing tier selection UI based on number of compositions. Create checkout flow with order summary and payment form. Develop order confirmation system with receipts and email notifications. Set up webhook handlers for payment status updates. Implement subscription tracking in the user profile. Create admin dashboard for payment monitoring. Handle payment failures and retry scenarios.
tasks.testStrategy: Test payment processing with Stripe test keys for all pricing tiers. Verify checkout flow with various payment methods. Test error handling for declined payments. Validate that order confirmations and receipts are correctly generated. Ensure subscription status is accurately reflected in the user profile.

tasks.title: Redesign Review Page
tasks.description: Redesign and implement the Review page according to the new design mockups with improved user interface and experience.
tasks.details: Update the page layout to match the design's card-less appearance. Implement progress tracker showing completed steps (Add Styles, Checkout, Upload Photos) and current step (Generate). Update the form fields to match the design (gender, eye color, age, body type, height, weight, ethnicity, glasses). Create responsive photo grid with quality indicator (81%). Implement tabbed interface for Photos/Edit. Style the Style Cards based on the design mockup. Create footer area with disclaimer text and links to requirements documents. Implement the Generate button with proper styling and hover states.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the redesigned page across multiple screen sizes to verify responsive behavior. Verify all form fields save and load correctly. Test the tabs functionality for Photos/Edit. Ensure the progress tracker correctly shows the appropriate step. Validate that the Generate button properly submits the form and navigates to the next step. Test accessibility for all UI components.

subtasks.title: Implement Progress Tracker Component
subtasks.description: Create a responsive progress tracker component that shows completed steps (Add Styles, Checkout, Upload Photos) and current step (Generate).
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a new React component called ProgressTracker
2. Implement the UI with step indicators showing completed and current steps
3. Style each step with appropriate icons and colors (completed steps in green with checkmarks, current step highlighted)
4. Make the component responsive for different screen sizes
5. Add appropriate animations for step transitions
6. Testing approach: Verify correct display on different viewport sizes and that the correct step is highlighted based on the current page

subtasks.title: Restructure Page Layout
subtasks.description: Update the overall page layout to match the new card-less design and prepare the container structure for all components.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Remove existing card-based containers from the Review page
2. Create a clean, modern layout with proper spacing according to mockups
3. Set up grid/flex layouts for responsive behavior
4. Implement container divs for each major section (progress tracker, form fields, photo grid, style cards, footer)
5. Add appropriate CSS variables for consistent styling
6. Testing approach: Verify layout matches design across different screen sizes and that container structure properly accommodates all components

subtasks.title: Build User Profile Form
subtasks.description: Create the updated form fields for user profile information including gender, eye color, age, body type, height, weight, ethnicity, and glasses.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create form component with all required fields from mockup
2. Implement appropriate input types for each field (dropdowns, radio buttons, etc.)
3. Add validation for required fields and proper input formats
4. Style form elements according to design (fonts, spacing, colors)
5. Implement responsive behavior for the form
6. Add state management for form data
7. Testing approach: Test form validation, responsive layout, and proper state management for all input fields

subtasks.title: Develop Photo Grid with Quality Indicator
subtasks.description: Implement the responsive photo grid that displays uploaded photos with a quality indicator showing the overall quality percentage (81%).
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a responsive grid component for displaying uploaded photos
2. Implement the quality indicator UI element showing percentage (81%)
3. Add appropriate styling for the photo containers
4. Implement the tabbed interface for Photos/Edit sections
5. Add hover states and interactions for the photos
6. Ensure proper responsive behavior for different screen sizes
7. Testing approach: Test grid layout with different numbers of photos, verify quality indicator displays correctly, and check tab switching functionality

subtasks.title: Create Style Cards Component
subtasks.description: Implement the redesigned Style Cards component based on the mockup that displays the user's selected styles.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create a new Style Card component matching the design mockup
2. Implement the layout for displaying style information and thumbnails
3. Add proper styling for fonts, colors, and spacing according to design
4. Create hover states and interactions for the style cards
5. Implement responsive behavior for different screen sizes
6. Add functionality to display the correct style information from the user's selections
7. Testing approach: Test display with different style selections, verify responsive behavior, and check all interactive elements work correctly

subtasks.title: Implement Footer and Generate Button
subtasks.description: Create the footer area with disclaimer text and links to requirements documents, and implement the Generate button with proper styling and hover states.
subtasks.details:
Implementation details:
1. Create footer component with disclaimer text and requirements links
2. Implement the Generate button with proper styling and hover effects
3. Add appropriate click handlers for the Generate button
4. Implement loading state for the Generate button
5. Add animations for button interactions
6. Ensure proper responsive behavior for the footer and button
7. Testing approach: Test button interactions, verify links work correctly, and check responsive layout of footer across different screen sizes

tasks.title: Develop Photo Upload System with Quality Checking
tasks.description: Create an intelligent photo upload system with real-time quality checking using OpenCV.js and feedback mechanisms.
tasks.details: Implement drag-and-drop and file selection UI for photo uploads. Integrate OpenCV.js for face detection and quality metrics (resolution, lighting, face visibility). Create Sharp.js pipeline for image optimization and processing. Develop real-time feedback system for photo quality issues with specific improvement suggestions. Implement batch upload capability with progress indicators. Store uploaded photos in S3 with references in the Images table.
tasks.testStrategy: Test with various photo qualities to verify detection of issues. Validate face detection accuracy across different types of photos. Test upload performance with multiple simultaneous uploads. Verify that quality feedback is accurate and helpful. Ensure processed images maintain sufficient quality for AI processing.

subtasks.title: Implement Photo Upload UI with Drag-and-Drop and File Selection
subtasks.description: Create the user interface for photo uploads including drag-and-drop functionality, file selection dialog, and the initial upload handling structure.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Create a responsive drop zone component that supports both drag-and-drop and traditional file selection.
2. Add visual feedback for when files are dragged over the drop zone (highlight effect).
3. Implement client-side file type validation (accept only images: jpg, png, etc.).
4. Add initial file size validation to prevent extremely large uploads.
5. Develop a thumbnail preview system that shows selected images before upload.
6. Implement a basic progress indicator structure that will be enhanced in later subtasks.
7. Set up the event handlers for file selection and drop events.
8. Create the initial upload queue management system.

Testing approach:
- Verify that both drag-and-drop and file selection buttons work correctly.
- Test with various file types to ensure only images are accepted.
- Confirm the UI provides appropriate feedback during different upload states.
- Test across different browsers and devices to ensure compatibility.

subtasks.title: Integrate OpenCV.js for Photo Quality Analysis
subtasks.description: Implement the core image quality checking functionality using OpenCV.js, including face detection and quality metrics evaluation.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Set up OpenCV.js library integration in the project.
2. Create a service for image analysis that will run before upload completion.
3. Implement face detection algorithm using OpenCV.js Haar cascades or similar approach.
4. Add quality metric calculations for:
   - Image resolution verification (minimum acceptable dimensions)
   - Brightness and contrast assessment
   - Face visibility and positioning (centered, not too close to edges)
   - Blur detection
5. Develop a quality scoring system that combines multiple metrics.
6. Create specific feedback messages for each type of quality issue.
7. Implement real-time analysis so feedback appears as soon as images are selected.
8. Add visual indicators on thumbnails showing quality status (good/needs improvement).

Testing approach:
- Test with various sample images of different qualities.
- Verify face detection works correctly with different face positions and lighting conditions.
- Confirm quality metrics provide accurate assessments.
- Measure performance to ensure analysis doesn't significantly delay the user experience.
- Test edge cases like images with multiple faces or unusual lighting conditions.

subtasks.title: Develop Image Processing Pipeline and S3 Storage Integration
subtasks.description: Implement the server-side image processing with Sharp.js, batch upload functionality with progress tracking, and storage in S3 with database references.
subtasks.details:
Implementation steps:
1. Set up Sharp.js for server-side image processing and optimization.
2. Create processing pipeline that includes:
   - Automatic image optimization based on quality analysis
   - Resizing to standard dimensions if needed
   - Format conversion if beneficial
   - Metadata preservation/stripping as appropriate
3. Implement batch upload functionality that processes multiple files sequentially.
4. Add detailed progress tracking that shows status for each image in the batch.
5. Set up S3 bucket connection and secure upload configuration.
6. Create database schema for the Images table to store metadata and references.
7. Implement server endpoints to handle upload requests and return S3 URLs.
8. Add error handling and retry logic for failed uploads.
9. Implement cleanup procedures for incomplete uploads.
10. Add final success/failure notifications to the user.

Testing approach:
- Test the complete pipeline with various image types and qualities.
- Verify batch uploads work correctly with progress reporting.
- Confirm images are properly stored in S3 with correct metadata.
- Test database entries are created correctly with proper references.
- Verify error handling by simulating network issues and server errors.
- Perform load testing with large batches of photos.

tasks.title: Integrate AI Generation Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement the AI generation pipeline with Replicate API integration for headshot generation using the specified models and workflows.
tasks.details: Set up Replicate API integration with authentication and error handling. Implement the training pipeline using 'ostris/flux-dev-lora-trainer' for processing user photos. Create ComfyUI workflow configuration for inference using Flux-dev, trained LoRAs, and upscalers. Develop a queuing system for processing multiple compositions. Implement progress tracking and status updates. Set up webhook handlers for completion notifications. Store generated images in S3 and update references in the database.
tasks.testStrategy: Test the AI pipeline with sample images to verify generation quality. Validate error handling and retry mechanisms. Test the queuing system with multiple simultaneous requests. Verify that progress tracking accurately reflects the generation status. Ensure generated images meet quality standards and match selected styles.

tasks.title: Build User Dashboard
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive user dashboard for managing compositions, tracking generation progress, and viewing/downloading generated headshots.
tasks.details: Design and implement dashboard UI with sections for active compositions, generation progress, and completed headshots. Create real-time status updates using Supabase subscriptions or polling. Implement image gallery view with filtering and sorting options. Develop image preview functionality with zoom and pan controls. Create batch download options for headshots. Implement favorite/tagging system for organizing headshots. Add email notification system for completion alerts.
tasks.testStrategy: Test dashboard rendering with various user scenarios (new user, returning user with in-progress generations, user with completed headshots). Verify real-time updates work correctly. Test image gallery with large numbers of images. Validate that download functionality works for single and batch operations. Test email notifications for reliability and content accuracy.

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Implement Caching
tasks.description: Enhance application performance through optimization techniques, caching strategies, and CDN integration.
tasks.details: Implement client-side caching for UI assets and style previews. Set up server-side caching for API responses and database queries. Integrate a CDN (like Cloudflare or AWS CloudFront) for static assets and generated images. Optimize image loading with lazy loading and progressive enhancement. Implement performance monitoring and logging. Add prefetching for common navigation paths. Optimize database queries with proper indexing.
tasks.testStrategy: Measure performance metrics before and after optimization using Lighthouse and Web Vitals. Test application performance under load with simulated concurrent users. Verify that caching strategies work correctly by monitoring cache hit rates. Test CDN integration by accessing the application from different geographic locations.

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Fallback Mechanisms
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive error handling, monitoring, and fallback systems to ensure reliability of the application.
tasks.details: Implement global error boundary in React for graceful UI error handling. Create consistent error messaging system for user-facing errors. Set up logging infrastructure for server-side and client-side errors. Implement retry mechanisms for transient failures in API calls. Create fallback UI components for when primary content fails to load. Develop AI processing fallback strategy for when primary provider is unavailable. Set up monitoring alerts for critical system components. Create a status page for system health.
tasks.testStrategy: Test error handling by deliberately introducing errors in different parts of the application. Verify that retry mechanisms work correctly for API failures. Test fallback UI components by simulating component failures. Validate that error logs contain sufficient information for debugging. Test monitoring alerts by triggering threshold conditions.
